source_text: σὺ δὲ μένε ἐν οἷς ἔμαθες καὶ ἐπιστώθης, εἰδὼς παρὰ ⸀τίνων ἔμαθες,
english_snapshot: But as for you[a], remain in what you learned and became convinced of, knowing from whom you learned it[b],

signals.text: Some manuscripts read 'from whom' in the singular ('from whom' = one person), often understood as Paul; the plural reading followed here may point more broadly to Timothy's teachers.

source_text: Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ χαλκεὺς πολλά μοι κακὰ ἐνεδείξατο— ⸀ἀποδώσει αὐτῷ ὁ κύριος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ—
english_snapshot: Alexander the metalworker showed me many evils[c][b][a]; the Lord will repay him according to his works.

signals.text: Some manuscripts read, 'May the Lord repay him according to his works.'
